reason: It touches `pkg/executor`, but the subject and file spread point to a code-organization split of existing executor implementations out of `executor.go`, not a metadata signal of changed planner/optimizer, session/transaction, privilege, parser, statistics, or KV semantics. Most touched files are narrow executor handlers (`SHOW*`, DDL-job ops, index recommendation/check), so despite being in a central package, this looks more like a mechanical refactor than a PR likely to hide Blocker/High issues.
